original_test_intent: Run an approved one-hour BurnIn workload spanning CPU, memory, GPU and network, proving sustained load without platform errors, hang or blue screen.
original_method: Bind the validated BurnInTest package/config, preserve baseline logs before any approved clear, boot and run the specified one-hour workload under continuous thermal/power/error monitoring, then compare BurnIn, BMC and OS evidence and final health.
manual_activity: The owner approves sustained system stress and log policy, supplies the BurnInTest package/configuration and limits, and supervises power-on, workload launch and emergency recovery.
required_inputs: Approved BurnInTest binary, license and immutable configuration
CPU, memory, GPU and network workload definitions
safety_requirements: Do not use the PSU sensor substitution
Abort on hang, blue screen, reset, XID, ECC/PCIe/network or sensor limits
agent_execution_scope: Run only the approved one-hour profile after confirmation
Collect per-subsystem utilization, sensors and errors
Stop on defined abort and compare final health without verdict

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One-hour BurnIn, CPU/memory/GPU/network load, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen criteria, script and 30/60-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a baseline-approved-load-continuous-monitor-posthealth sequence across all named subsystems.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines immutable package/configuration, safe limits, evidence retention and abort/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU sensor activity cannot substitute for CPU/memory/GPU/network burn-in or OS stability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Combined load can expose or worsen thermal, power, memory, GPU, network or firmware faults.

project_override_considerations: Alternative stress tools require an explicit equivalence matrix proving the same four-subsystem load, one-hour duration and acceptance coverage; otherwise uncovered areas must be recorded.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/version and BurnIn package/config hashes
Preserved pre-test BMC/OS/event/sensor/device baseline and log-clear audit
One-hour raw BurnIn output and per-subsystem load timeline
Post-test health, recovery/final state and engineer verdict
